title: Delft University of Technology
subtitle: BSc Computer Science and Engineering
paragraph: I am the 9th highest scoring CS/Math student in the Netherland for 2023/24 with a strong academic record, completing all courses on my first attempt. I am passionate about expanding my knowledge of algorithms, machine learning, and web dev.

title: Staszic High School in Lublin
subtitle: International Baccalaureate DP
paragraph: I graduated high school as the valedictorian, which was an incredible honor. During my time there I also placed 4th in the team competition at International Mathematics Olympiad ISMTF. Additionally, I received the Prime Minister's Scholarship in recognition of the outstanding academic performance throughout high school.

title: Delft University of Technology
subtitle: Teaching Assistant
paragraph: I work as a Teaching Assistant (TA) for Web and Database Technology and Information and Data Management courses. As a TA, my role is to help students grasp concepts they find difficult during the lab sessions. The topics covered in the course include: database design, (non-)relational database systems, SQL, web front-end and back-end development, and more.

title: Lanterna Education
subtitle: IB DP Mathematics Tutor
paragraph: Lanterna is a leading online tutoring platform known for its rigorous hiring process, requiring strong teaching abilities and exceptional communication skills. It is through this comapny that I provided high-quality tutoring sessions in IB DP Mathematics course.

title: PRIME - TU Delft
subtitle: Teaching Assistant
paragraph: "The PRogramme of Innovation in Mathematics Education (PRIME) is all about redesigning mathematics courses for engineers." It is at PRIME that I have the opportunity to contribute to improving the quality of mathematics education for engineers at TU Delft through various projects.

title: TeachBooks - TU Delft
subtitle: Teaching Assistant - Developer
paragraph: At TeachBooks, I help with the development of interactive textbooks using the JupyterBook platform with features like embedded exercises, visualizations, and applets. It is at TeachBooks where I can combine my passion for education and computer science.

title: Google
subtitle: SWE Intern
paragraph: At Google, together with my team, we are developing an Automated Sales Enablement Program Builder, which is a web application designed to automate and centralize the creation and management of sales enablement curricula.
